Story title.title: A partner behind the finest hospitality experiences.

Story body 1.paragraph: ONORA Hotel Supplies was founded with a simple belief: every guest experience is shaped by the details on the table. From our office in Karama, Dubai, we source, curate and deliver premium tableware, glassware, buffet, bar and service equipment for hotels, restaurants, cafés and caterers across the UAE.

Story body 2.paragraph: Working alongside world-renowned manufacturers from Europe and Asia, we help hospitality teams choose products that look beautiful, perform under pressure and stay within budget — from a single outlet refresh to a full pre-opening package.

style.Our story: flex-direction: column; padding: 120px max(40px, calc((100% - 1350px) / 2)); gap: 64px; position: relative; overflow: hidden; @media(--tablet){ padding: 96px 40px; gap: 48px; } @media(--mobile){ padding: 72px 20px; gap: 40px; } background: #FFFFFF;
style.Story row: padding: 0px; gap: 96px; align-items: center; overflow: hidden; @media(--tablet){ flex-direction: column; gap: 64px; } @media(--mobile){ flex-direction: column; gap: 48px; }
style.Story composition: position: relative; width: 560px; min-width: 560px; height: 640px; padding: 0px; @media(--mobile){ width: 100%; min-width: 0px; height: 470px; }
style.Story main image: position: absolute; left: 0px; top: 0px; width: 470px; height: 580px; object-fit: cover; @media(--mobile){ width: 86%; height: 400px; }
style.Story inset image: position: absolute; left: 310px; top: 390px; width: 230px; height: 230px; object-fit: cover; border-width: 10px; border-style: solid; border-color: #FFFFFF; @media(--mobile){ left: auto; right: 0px; top: 300px; width: 154px; height: 154px; border-width: 8px; }
style.Story ring: position: absolute; left: -60px; top: -60px; width: 220px; height: 220px; min-width: 220px; padding: 0px; border-radius: 50%; border-width: 1.2px; border-style: solid; border-color: rgba(201,150,46,0.6); z-index: 0;
style.Story badge: position: absolute; left: 30px; top: 470px; width: auto; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; padding: 22px 26px; background: var(--on-navy); align-items: flex-start; @media(--mobile){ left: 16px; top: 240px; padding: 16px 20px; }
style.Badge title: font-family: var(--on-serif); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.3px; font-size: 30px; line-height: 31px; color: #FFFFFF; @media(--mobile){ font-size: 24px; line-height: 26px; }
style.Badge sub: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 600; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 2px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--on-gold-soft); line-height: 1.2;
style.Story text: flex-direction: column; gap: 26px; padding: 0px; flex: 1 1 0px; min-width: 0px; align-items: flex-start; @media(--tablet){ flex: 0 0 auto; } @media(--mobile){ flex: 0 0 auto; }
style.Story label row: padding: 0px; width: auto; gap: 14px; align-items: center;
style.Story rule: width: 32px; min-width: 32px; height: 2px; padding: 0px; background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, #A5740B 0%, #DEAF57 25%, #F1C96A 50%, #BE8826 75%, #A5740B 100%);
style.Story label: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 600; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 3px; text-transform: uppercase; color: #C9962E; line-height: 1.2;
style.Story title: font-family: var(--on-serif); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.3px; font-size: 56px; line-height: 58px; color: var(--on-navy); @media(--tablet){ font-size: 46px; line-height: 50px; } @media(--mobile){ font-size: 36px; line-height: 40px; }
style.Story body 1: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 400; font-size: 16px; line-height: 29px; color: var(--on-muted);
style.Story body 2: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 400; font-size: 16px; line-height: 29px; color: var(--on-muted);
